generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Node.js (no-deps) RS274-style G-code simulator CLI in `output/`, runnable as:

- `node output/main.js --input <file> --output <result.json> [options]`

Key files:
- `output/main.js` (entry point)
- `output/src/simulator.js` (core execution + state + trace emission)
- `output/src/gcode_parser.js` + `output/src/expr.js` (block parsing + expression/parameter evaluation)
- `output/src/parameters.js` + `output/src/tool_table.js` (RS274 parameter/tool file readers + parameter writer)
- `output/src/trace.js` (delta-trace diffing)
- `output/src/cli.js` (argument parsing)

Supports required flags (`--input`, `--output`) and optional flags described in your prompt, including `--trace-output` with exactly one stepping mode, plus `--tool-table`, `--parameter-input/--parameter-output`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--probe-box`, and `--probe-tool`.

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
